_doc: Optional per-template overrides. Each entry's id must match the filename without extension. quad: [[x0,y0],[x1,y1],[x2,y2],[x3,y3]] in normalized [0..1] coordinates of the base bitmap, ordered top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left. Templates not listed here use the category defaults (henna: MULTIPLY @ 0.85, 18% inset).
